case: Schäfer & Turek (1996) 2D-2 — in-channel cylinder, Re = 100 (unsteady, vortex shedding)
problem: 2D laminar flow past a circular cylinder confined in a channel; drag coefficient (primary), lift amplitude, Strouhal number and front/rear pressure difference as validation quantities

dimensionless.cd_normalisation: Cd = Fx / (0.5 * rho * U_mean^2 * D_phys), D_phys = 0.1
dimensionless.dp_normalisation: dp_upstream - dp_downstream at y = 0.2 between x = 0.15 and x = 0.25

ref.source: Schäfer, M. & Turek, S. (1996), Benchmark computations of laminar flow around a cylinder, NNFM 48, Vieweg, pp. 547-566, case 2D-2 quantities table (Table 3)

provenance.source_kind: literature benchmark (grid-converged FEM reference solution), frozen in-repo register
provenance.print_original: The NNFM 48 PDF is not reachable from the offline work tree (no network, no copy under references/). The bands are transcribed from the in-repo register plus two pre-existing in-repo records (benchmarks/roadmap.md, benchmarks/pending/cylinder_re40_st/result.json); the register states this limitation explicitly.
provenance.unit_note: Table 3 quotes dp in rho*U_mean^2 units (2.46-2.50). The LBM runner normalises with q = 0.5*rho*u_lb^2, therefore the comparison band is the same interval expressed in 0.5*rho*U^2 units (4.92-5.00). Mixing the two conventions is a silent factor-2 error; the module carries both bands explicitly (mission m15918 fix).
